limitations: Family membership and reviewed structural disposition are not correctness or conformance evidence.
P0 records exact static callsites in the revision-bound product-usage snapshot; it does not prove runtime reachability or frequency.
A Python and REST surface sharing a family name are related review subjects, not automatically transport-equivalent.
Source-only exposure means the public Python facade; it does not mean a product user can inspect the derivation.

priority_policy.P0: Reserved for confirmed production-user call paths in the Stage 3 usage snapshot.
priority_policy.P1: Public REST calculation not yet confirmed as a production-user call path.
priority_policy.P2: Python-facade calculation without an independently confirmed production-user call path.

roots.root_record: Local path deliberately omitted; product name and the exact committed Git tree are the portable identity.
Local path deliberately omitted; product name and the exact committed Git tree are the portable identity.

review_policy.boundary: Structural family review against the GAP-007 audit, current inventory ownership, documentation leads, test leads, response contracts, and product usage. Reviewed does not mean conformant, numerically validated, or release verified.

scope_rule: Every in-scope canonical surface is assigned to exactly one primary family. Aliases remain visible and inherit no independent conformance claim.
